title: How ATHENA turns a rough idea into a storyboard
source_note: Drawn from the project code (the LangGraph wiring and node modules). Entry routing is from reading the code, not from a live run. Team project.

steps.title: You give it a rough idea
steps.body: You write a short brief. One language model reads it once and decides the whole plan: which steps to run, which to skip, and whether to research. Plain code then follows that plan, so no model is steering the run.
steps.plan_note: Decided once, then followed by ordinary code. It can pause to ask you a clarifying question.

steps.title: A graph of eight steps does the work
steps.body: Each step reads what the earlier ones wrote and adds its own piece. Click a step to see what it does.

steps.title: Inside 'work on each scene'
steps.body: This one step loops over every scene. A failure in one scene does not stop the others.
steps.research_label: Research tools (an MCP server, a standard way to offer tools to a model)

steps.title: Nothing is redone twice
steps.caption: Steps whose output already exists are skipped, which is how runs resume and how an edit redoes only what it affects.

steps.title: Where it is today
steps.body: Some parts work, some are half done, and one is only an idea.

nodes.label: Understand the idea
nodes.what: Reads your brief and writes the plan.
nodes.makes: The intent and the plan, or a question for you.

nodes.label: Brainstorm
nodes.what: Comes up with ideas and picks one, keeping the others.
nodes.makes: One chosen concept with its reason.

nodes.label: Design characters
nodes.what: Designs who is in the story, unless the plan says no characters are needed.

nodes.label: Build the world
nodes.what: Sets the place, the time period and the mood, unless the plan says it is not needed.

nodes.label: Write the story
nodes.what: Combines the concept, characters and world into a story told in beats.

nodes.label: Split into scenes
nodes.what: Cuts the story into ordered scenes.
nodes.makes: Empty scene shells, ready to fill.

nodes.label: Work on each scene
nodes.what: Runs the scene and shot steps in order, one scene at a time.
nodes.makes: Scripts, looks, shots and images for each scene.

nodes.label: Assemble the storyboard
nodes.what: Collects everything into one project and writes the editable storyboard files.
nodes.makes: The storyboard as a data file and a web page.

inner.label: Research the scene
inner.what: Looks things up for the scene. Skipped if research is off or already done. A failed lookup does not stop the run.

tools.label: Web search
tools.what: Keyless web search with backup engines.

tools.label: Page fetch
tools.what: Reads a page as plain text. Offered by the MCP server only.

tools.label: Image search
tools.what: Finds reference images and their licence.

tools.label: YouTube search
tools.what: Finds videos. Needs an API key.

tools.label: YouTube transcript
tools.what: Gets the words spoken in one video. Needs an API key.

inner.label: Write the script
inner.what: Drafts narration, stage directions and dialogue.

inner.label: Set the look
inner.what: Chooses lighting, colour, mood and style.

inner.label: Plan the shots
inner.what: Splits the scene into ordered shots with camera angle and framing.

inner.label: Write the image prompt
inner.what: Describes one shot to the image model, keeping characters consistent.

inner.label: Generate the image
inner.what: Checks the prompt, then asks the image model. If it errors, a backup model is tried. If all fail, a marked placeholder is kept.
inner.note: An image fix is not yet re-verified end to end.

tools.label: Image model
tools.what: A FLUX model through NVIDIA NIM.

tools.label: Fallback model
tools.what: A different FLUX model, tried if the first one errors.

inner.label: Check the scene
inner.what: Reports what a viewer might understand or miss. It is a signal only, with no repair loop.

entries.label: With scenes
entries.note: Routes the same way as a script in the code.

entries.label: Visuals only
entries.note: Whether the look step runs well without a script was not checked.

today.label: Routing, resume and tools
today.what: Skipping steps, resuming a run and the research tools work.

today.label: Image generation and scene evaluator
today.what: An image fix is not yet re-verified end to end. The evaluator reads text only.

today.label: Video generation from the storyboard
today.what: A possible next step. It is not built and is not part of the graph.
